stem: Find the line passing through the two points $(1, 2)$ and $(3, 10)$. Drag the two points so the line is that line.

hints.text: Gradient is change in y over change in x, between the two given points.
Subtract the coordinates of the points in the same order top and bottom.
Use one of the given points in y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) to find where the line meets the y-axis.
Find the gradient from the two points first.

notes: Points (1,2),(3,10) are off the default board, but the line has board points (0,-2),(1,2).
